description:
Phase 5. LANDED (PRs #193 + #194): olivine idle spin-down (opt-in idle_timeout worker param, client-reads-only activity, compaction-format snapshot upload gating the exit, {:shutdown, :idle}, deferred foreman self-removal after own exit) and the distributor's idle branch ({:shutdown, :idle} -> park without recruit; degraded park falls back to heal since only a recruit's publication corrects the keyspace; idle check defers while :locked or compacting; unlock resets the idle clock).

REMAINING:
1. Production wiring for "idle_timeout" (deliberately deferred from PR #194 / audit F4): nothing sets the param yet — recruitment_ctx carries no worker_params. Decide the config source (cluster config knob handed through the director's recruitment_ctx) and a default policy; the opt-in shape means the system shard stays exempt by construction.
2. Re-adoption residue: recovery's locking phase already locks every advertised materializer and bootstrap adopts every locked survivor, so the residue targets candidates the locking phase MISSED (down at recovery, advertised later). Plan: recruitment_ctx gains the director's services snapshot; the startup sweep runs a one-shot deadline-bounded :shard_id identification over materializer services, adopts matches for uncovered tags (bounded lock at epoch -> unlock at the worker's OWN durable version with pull sources -> publish under the fence -> monitor; NEVER remove — provenance stays encoded in return shape like phase-a), recruits the rest on completion; demand recruitment short-circuits during the window (dedupe via the recruiting set).

RESIDUALS inherited from bedrock-q67.21.4 (audits of PRs #190/#191):
- N2: emit a covered-before-caught-up telemetry breadcrumb — a freshly recruited materializer is published as covered while still drinking its stream suffix.
- Placeholder fit: repo traffic parks ~50ms per attempt (builder fetch timeout) with the repo backoff loop doing the waiting; consider a hold-aware fetch timeout for known-placeholder routes; decide with measurements.
title: Idle spin-down + re-adoption residue
